page.running_head: De Authoritate,& Dignitate Cap. I. / Bellarminus

main_text.p: e Bellar quo supra Lib.I. §. secundo.{e}Secundus modus est, quia solus Episcopus Romanus totius Eccle-siæ Papa dicitur, ut ibidem patet.
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO.
main_text.p: PAtet omninò, Pater quoad curam & solicitudinem, quemadmodum Cyprianus (indefinitè) {*}Christianorum Papa. Par pari refero;ecquid te mordet? facessant igitur istæ nugæ næniaeque.*supra, lib. o. p.
main_text.head: Tertius modus colligendi Primatum, ex nomine Papæ.

p.i: {u}Ipse Rom. Pontifex ab aliis salutatus neminem vocat Patrem, sed omnes filios, vel fratres.

main_text.head: Sect. XIII.I. ANIMADVERSIO. Papam Rom. dum Fraternitatem despicit, Paternitatem suam amittere[?].
main_text.p: HÆc est eiusdem ferculi placēta peræq; insipida;nam (vobis etiam fatentibus) {x}Cornelius Episcopus Rom. & alij multi Cyprianum Carthaginensem Episcopum Papam, & Papatem vocárunt:& Epiphanius Epistolam ad Hormisdam Rom. Episcopum sic inscribit, {y}Sanctissimo & beatissimo Domino fratri comministro Hormisdæ salutem. Tu itaque, Bellarmine, qui Patris appellatione, indefinitè sumptâ, Pontificis Primatum demonstrari putas; Fratris autem (si forte illi attribueretur) attenuari atque diminui; has, quas retulimus, salutationes æquâ iam lance perpende. Nam si in voce, Pater, tanta vis inest, vt Primatum evincat, tùm, ex sententia Rom Pontificis, iste Primatus Cyprianus est deferendus; quia Cornelius Pontifex, aliíque multi Cyprianum Papam, idèst, {z}Patrem Patrum voca-runt.x Onuphr. vbi supra, initio Tractá. vacuum obscur.y Binius Tom.2 Conc pag.418.z Schmeron Ies. Prolegom. in Epist. ad Icm disp. 14. pag.272,col.2.

page.notes: Marginal reference marks are reproduced as printed; the mark before "Secundus" is read as "e" and the mark before "Christianorum" as "*", both doubtful. "Cyprianus" and "Papa" are italic as printed. Marginal note "Cypria :o" in the text reads uncertainly; the "Cyprianus" spelling in the line "Cypria :o est deferendus" is marked as doubtful. The mark after "Cornelius Episcopus" and similar superscripts were read as x, y, z by position. The printed "amitterᴗ" end of the heading is a printer's symbol, marked [?]. Left margin notes are copied as printed; "Schmeron" and "Ies." are read from small type and may be imperfect.
